response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced engineer with genuine developer-tooling interest (IDE components at National Instruments, test runners, MCP code generators), but his core stack is TypeScript/Node.js and DLang, not Java/Kotlin. The role's hard requirements — deep JVM expertise, Kotlin, and solid Spring/enterprise framework experience — are essentially absent from his background, making the fit weak despite his seniority and craftsmanship.
strengths: Prior IDE development experience (C/C++ components for NI LabWindows/CVI) and demonstrated interest in developer tooling
Strong software craftsmanship background: TDD, CI/CD, open-source libraries, and community teaching
Proven experience with complex, high-scale systems (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
concerns: No Kotlin experience and only minor, dated Java exposure; lacks the required deep JVM expertise
No evidence of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or other enterprise Java framework experience
Recent work centers on TypeScript/Node full-stack product development, far from JVM tooling
